title: TOEIC® Listening - Versión 2: Logistics & International Shipping
description: Prueba intensiva de comprensión auditiva TOEIC® enfocada en el contexto de ApexCorp con the Operations Chief.

parts.visual:
## 📸 Simulación de Auditiva: ApexCorp

Evaluaremos tu destreza auditiva en el contexto de **ApexCorp** (Líder a cargo: **the Operations Chief**).

Concéntrate plenamente en las descripciones y los audios corporativos.
parts.audio: Welcome to this specialized TOEIC Listening drill. Listen closely to the speaker options and pick the best description of the workspace. Good luck!

questions.question: [PART 1 - PHOTOGRAPH]: Look at the business picture of ApexCorp's office staff. Select the correct description.
questions.audio_script: A) They are loading packages onto the truck. B) They are signing the shipping invoices. C) The warehouse doors are closed. D) They are reviewing the freight shipping terms.
questions.explanation: La descripción correcta es la D, ya que se ve a los agentes de logística revisando las cláusulas del flete marítimo.

questions.question: [PART 3 - CONVERSATION]: Listen to the conversation and answer: What is the main issue discussed by the speakers?
questions.audio_script:
M: Hi Emily, did you get a chance to review the logistics invoice from ApexCorp?
W: Yes. The freight rates are reasonable, but the port clearance fee is higher than expected.
M: Let's call the Operations Chief to request a waiver.
options: The contract pricing is too high.
The delivery window is too narrow for their schedule.
They want to cancel the shipment.
The company wants to buy ApexCRM.
questions.correct_answer: The delivery window is too narrow for their schedule.
questions.explanation: La mujer menciona explícitamente: 'pricing is competitive, but their delivery window is too narrow for our schedule'.
